# Career Boost

> AI career coach that optimizes resumes for ATS systems, generates tailored cover letters, and helps job seekers land more interviews.

Career Boost analyzes your resume against any job description, scoring ATS compatibility, surfacing missing keywords, and generating an optimized resume and cover letter in under a minute.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Career Boost and how AI resume optimization works.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Free, Pro Plan 1 (₦5,000/mo), and Pro Plan 2 (₦10,000/mo) — features and limits.
- [Support](/support): Get help via WhatsApp with resumes, billing, and account questions.
- [Sign in](/auth): Sign in or create an account to start optimizing your resume.
